citation.title: Avoidance of Disruptions on KSTAR due to Vertical Displacement Events via Novel Real-Time Stability Assessment
citation.authors: M. Tobin, S. A. Sabbagh, V. Zamkovska, G. Bustos-Ramirez, H. K. Lee, J. R. Jepson, J. Riquezes, F. Sheehan, G. Tillinghast, K. Erickson, R. Shousha, Y. Lee, J. Barr, M. H. Woo, Y. S. Park
citation.venue: Unknown (AIP accepted manuscript; journal name not stated in extracted text)
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1063/5.0320639 (printed in the manuscript's own 'please cite' banner)

topic: Real-time KSTAR VDE stability metric computed from magnetics-derived PCA current-density surrogate, used for shape and ECCD avoidance control.
own_question: Can a semi-empirical vertical force-gradient metric, fed by a fast linear magnetics-to-PCA current-profile model, forecast and avoid VDEs on KSTAR?
actual_method_and_evidence: Authors report a linear map from 144 magnetic probes to the top-10 PCA amplitudes of magnetics-only EFIT current profiles. They report R2 0.994 on 16,794 points from 100 shots. These profiles are EFIT reference labels, not independent truth. Least-squares tuning of the M* matrix used 50 shots; the authors report 82.3% shot-level recall on 400 validation shots from the same campaign. They also report avoidance experiments in three scenarios. The PCS surrogate is reported as about 167x faster than rtEFIT; no absolute timing is stated. Nothing in the paper concerns CES, Ti, BES, ECEI or temporal nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: On KSTAR, fast linear surrogates trained on reconstruction outputs have been reported as substitutes for slower reconstruction-derived quantities in real-time control.
claim_checks.qualification: Reproduces magnetics-only EFIT labels, not physical truth. The target is a spatial current profile, not a temporal nowcast of an ion-temperature report. Field: current density, not ion temperature.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are magnetic probe measurements at the same time; the target is the concurrent EFIT current profile. This is a same-time spatial surrogate, not a forecast or a nowcast of a delayed report. The relative speed-up is reported; the absolute latency is unknown.
validation_if_relevant: Separate shot ranges from one campaign; how independent the splits are is unclear. The year labels conflict: the text cites 2024 and 2025 campaigns, and the summary says 2024. The paper reports no untouched-campaign test.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer anything about CES, ion temperature, BES or ECEI.
Do not treat EFIT-label R2 as physical accuracy.
Do not cite its VDE recall or speed-up as evidence for our task.
Do not call it a nowcasting precedent.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most an optional analogy for fast surrogate estimation on KSTAR. The diagnostic, physical quantity and temporal question all differ from ours, so it is likely best omitted.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
